Oberfield and Raval (2021), Micro Data and Macro Technology, Econometrica 89(2), 703–732. https://doi.org/10.3982/ECTA12807 and https://ezraoberfield.github.io/CESAggregation.pdf. Abstract and pp. 703–705 report capital–labor elasticity 0.5–0.7 for US manufacturing. rho=2 uses sigma=0.5 as a maintained analogy to a different V6 input margin. Do/rho_selection.md records Gechert et al. (2022) as additional evidence.
The retained 1.61 benchmark follows the project source audit for De Loecker, Eeckhout and Unger (2020), 2016 US sales-weighted markup. https://doi.org/10.1093/qje/qjz041. The model has a homogeneous intermediate producer. Firm aggregation, marginal-cost definition and a constant 2009–2024 markup remain assumptions. See Do/reference_audit.md and the Plan production literature review. The 3.5 case is diagnostic and has no adopted external calibration status.

See Do/reference_audit.md and the Plan production literature review. The 3.5 case is diagnostic and has no adopted external calibration status.
Oberfield and Raval (2021), Micro Data and Macro Technology, Econometrica 89(2), 703–732. https://doi.org/10.3982/ECTA12807 and https://ezraoberfield.github.io/CESAggregation.pdf. Abstract and pp. 703–705 report capital–labor elasticity 0.5–0.7 for US manufacturing. rho=2 uses sigma=0.5 as a maintained analogy to a different V6 input margin. Do/rho_selection.md records Gechert et al. (2022) as additional evidence.

Run: 2009–2024. All 16 dates are fitting observations. One annual period is a conditional production convention. The full OLG generation mapping and GE calibration are outside this run.
